summary: Comprehensive mobile audit at 375px (iPhone SE) and 414px (iPhone Plus) across all key pages: Homepage, Hamburger Menu, Knowledge Center, Admission, Ground0, REACH Diagnostic, Program, About, Compliance Library, Footer. Tested horizontal scroll, tap targets, text size, contrast, layout collapse.

ui_bugs.issue: Primary REACH CTA button is NOT visible above the fold on mobile. At 375px it is at y=1167 (812px fold). At 414px it is at y=1091 (896px fold). The hero section is 1441px tall on mobile — user must scroll ~350px to see the primary CTA. This is the most critical UX issue for mobile conversion.

ui_bugs.component: HeroSection / Labels - Boot-log lines and stat labels
ui_bugs.issue: Multiple text elements render below the 12px accessibility minimum: hero-boot-line-2 and hero-boot-line-3 are 9.43px, 'SYSTEM INITIALIZATION' label is 11.25px, 'AUTOMATIC FAILURE VIOLATIONS' stat label is 10.2px, various decorative spans are 10px. While some are intentionally micro/decorative, real content labels (stat badge text) below 12px hurt mobile readability for truckers reading at arm's length.

Seats text renders as '4 OF 12 SEATS FILLED THIS COHORT8 REMAINING' — missing separator/space before '8 REMAINING', creating a visual run-together on the narrow single-line at 375px. The line also fits tightly at full 375px width.

issues: Hero section is 1441px tall on mobile — primary CTA (REACH button) is 1167px from top, far below fold. Consider reducing hero content or adding a sticky mobile CTA strip.
Boot-log lines at 9.43px are unreadable at arm's length — consider hiding or increasing to >=12px on mobile.
Seats fill bar text 'THIS COHORT8 REMAINING' has missing space/separator — looks like '8' is concatenated directly to 'COHORT'.

action_items: CRITICAL: Reduce hero section height on mobile OR add a sticky/fixed mobile CTA strip so 'Run REACH Diagnostic' is always visible above fold at 375px. Current hero is 1441px tall — far too long.
MEDIUM: Increase boot-log line font size to >=12px on mobile, or set them display:none below 480px (they are decorative terminal text that reads as noise on small screens).
MEDIUM: Fix admission seats text — add a separator between 'COHORT' and '8 REMAINING' (likely a missing space or pipe character: e.g. 'THIS COHORT · 8 REMAINING').
LOW: Stat badge labels like 'AUTOMATIC FAILURE VIOLATIONS' render at 10.2px on mobile — increase to >=12px.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroSection.jsx: The hero min-height or content stack on mobile results in a 1441px section. The REACH CTA button is at absolute y=1167 at 375px viewport. This should have a mobile-specific layout that brings the CTA up significantly — either via reduced stacking order, a shorter hero text block, or a pinned mobile CTA.

Boot-log lines (absolutely positioned at top:34/47/60px, right:24px) are 9.43px computed at 375px — below 12px WCAG minimum. The CSS clamp or font-size for these lines needs a mobile floor of 12px or they should be hidden on mobile.
AdmissionPage.jsx: '4 OF 12 SEATS FILLED THIS COHORT' + '8 REMAINING' text — check if there is a missing whitespace between the dynamic cohort count and 'REMAINING' string.

success_rate.frontend: 72% — 3 mobile UX issues found; horizontal scroll, footer collapse, hamburger menu CTAs, form fields, doctrine grid, KC image hiding all PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile audit at 375px. Key passing items: no horizontal scroll on any page, hamburger menu shows gold CTAs first, footer collapses to 1 col, about doctrine grid 1 col, KC hero image hidden (parent display:none), admission form fields 327px wide and 61px+ tall. Key failing items: (1) REACH CTA at y=1167 on 375px — not above fold. (2) Boot-log text at 9.43px — below 12px min. (3) Admission seats text missing separator. Check [data-testid='hero-reach-cta'] position after any hero height fixes.

rca_of_issues.reach_btn_below_fold: The hero section stacks: nav bar + system init bar + eyebrow + h1 (two lines at 64.8px) + subheadline + body paragraph + bullet list + hero stats + THEN the REACH button. At 375px with 64.8px font h1, this stack totals ~1167px. Fix: reduce hero font size on mobile, collapse bullet list to 1-2 items, or move REACH btn immediately after h1/subheadline.
rca_of_issues.boot_log_too_small: Boot-log lines use a CSS class with font-size that computes to 9.43px at 375px. The 'SYSTEM INITIALIZATION' line is 11.25px. All are below the 12px WCAG floor. RCA: likely a clamp() or vw-based font-size that shrinks too far. Fix: add a media query or clamp floor of 12px, or hide these decorative elements below 480px.
rca_of_issues.admission_text_concat: Seats text is assembled from two variables joined without a space/separator. Check the JSX render in AdmissionPage.jsx for the fill bar caption.
